extension.description: Generate conventional Git commit messages from staged diffs using OpenAI / Claude / Gemini / Ollama and OpenAI-compatible providers (DeepSeek, Zhipu, Qwen, Groq, OpenRouter).
command.showAvailableModels: AI Commit: Show Available OpenAI Models
command.setApiKey: AI Commit: Set API Key (stored in SecretStorage)
config.streamingEnabled.description: Stream the generated commit message into the SCM input box character-by-character.
config.diffMaxTokens.description: Maximum approximate tokens of diff to send to the model. Larger diffs are truncated.
config.diffExcludePatterns.description: Additional regex patterns for file paths to exclude from the diff (applied on top of built-in defaults).
config.diffIncludeDefaultExcludes.descri: Use built-in exclude patterns for lock files, dist/, build/, .min files, etc.
